```plato

//==
// # Differential geometry: surface points and curvature
//
// Evaluated points and tangent planes of parametric surfaces, the curvature
// summaries computed there, and the fundamental forms and intrinsic metric data
// that generate them. Curvatures are in reciprocal world units; form components
// are per squared parameter unit.

//==
// # ISurface point data

// An evaluated point of a parametric surface: position, unit normal, and the
// (generally non-unit) tangent partial derivatives at parameter Uv.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Normal_(geometry))
type SurfacePoint3D
    implements IValue
{
    Position: Point3D;
    Normal: Direction3D;
    TangentU: Vector3D;
    TangentV: Vector3D;
    Uv: UvCoordinate;
}
```
